data.narrative:
Onebrief, a Series D defense and security software company founded by Grant Demaree and Rafa Pereira, is valued at $2.15B post-money following $336M in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private frontier-tech companies in defense and security (Helsing, Saronic, Chaos Industries, Anduril Industries, Shield AI, and others) plus 2 public comps.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical for Series D advancement to the $2.1B last post-money valuation, implying $3.2B. Peer-median analysis across the three closest same-stage, same-sector comparables—Helsing ($18.0B), Saronic ($9.2B), and Chaos Industries ($4.5B)—yields a median of $9.2B, with a range spanning $4.5B to $18.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in technology maturity and commercial traction within the cohort.

Triangulation across these two methods produces a valuation range of $2.7B (low) to $10.6B (high), with a median of $6.2B. The current $2.15B valuation sits below the stage-progression floor, suggesting upside to $3.2B–$6.2B under base-case assumptions. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, customer concentration, and product defensibility relative to the peer set, none of which are quantified here.
